title: A harmonized human glioblastoma chromatin accessibility atlas (snATAC-seq, 48 patients, 8 cohorts, 1.52M nuclei)
description:
Harmonized scATAC-seq / snMultiome atlas across 8 published GBM cohorts (48 patients with ≥50 cells per label group, 1,523,668 nuclei) with pan-malignant, per-cell-type, pan-myeloid, and Neftel-state (malignant_AC/MES/OPC/NPC) AAV enhancer candidate shortlists. Peak reference is the union of all cohorts' called peaks plus CATLAS, totaling 1,958,753 peaks (74.2% de-novo vs CATLAS).

Scoring: patient-level replication (primary), cohort-level batch sanity, per-non-target-cell-type contamination for AAV safety, and arm-adjusted Daigle Z (Allen Armamentarium Z ≥ 2 criterion with the null distribution computed per chromosome arm to remove chr7-gain / chr10-loss inflation). CNV annotation columns (chromosome_arm, chromosome_cnv_class, patient_fraction_chr7_elevated) are shipped alongside raw Z for transparency.

Canonical cohort slugs (first-author_year): greenwald_2024 (Greenwald Cell / E-MTAB-17183), sojka_2025 (Sojka Nat Cell Biol / GSE276177 — the earlier slug 'khan_astro' was a misattribution, corrected in v2026-10-11), sundaram_2024 (Sundaram Cell Rep / GDC dbGaP phs001287), zhao_2024 (Zhao CRM / HRA004942), mathewson_2021 (Mathewson Cell / GSE163654 + Wang 2024 Sci Adv), guo_2020 (Guo Nat Commun / GSE138794), guilhamon_2021 (Guilhamon eLife / GSE139136), raviram_2023 (Raviram et al. 2023 PNAS 120:e2210991120, sci-ATAC / GSE165037). All 8 cohorts contribute to BOTH the peak reference and scoring.

Primary deliverables: reports/top100_distal_combined.html (sortable, filterable, hover-definition table of the 12 headline reports), reports/top100_distal_combined.{csv,xlsx,parquet}, reports/top10_per_arm_combined.{csv,xlsx} (per-chromosome-arm CNV-diversity view), reports/detail/index.html (full per-report gallery with 4 Neftel-state drill-down reports), data/matrix/enhancer_candidate_matrix.parquet (1.96M peaks × 337 patient×cell-type pseudobulks), data/matrix/greenwald_fine_pseudobulk_backup.parquet (99-label fine-grained Greenwald pseudobulk preserved for future re-remapping), data/matrix/union_peak_reference.bed, data/matrix/peak_provenance.parquet, scripts/pileup_region.py (per-cohort fragment pileup for any region).

Pipeline source: github.com/jpmcginnis/HumanAAVProject (Glioblastoma snATACseq pipeline subdirectory).

notes: Prepared in support of a June 2026 NIH R01 submission for AAV-delivered cell-type-specific enhancer therapy in GBM. 100 kb distance cap deliberately omitted for AAV enhancer nomination (enhancer is extracted from genomic context in the viral cassette; native-genome distance to the nominally regulated gene is irrelevant). See SCHEMA.md for frozen column definitions and CHANGELOG.md for version history.
